title: Lenslet heuristic narrative for cache & batching recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Teams struggle to choose safe and cost-effective cache and batching settings for mixed conversational workloads. Current console surfaces raw knobs (batch size, max latency SLO, prefix cache TTL) but lacks an approachable narrative that ties recommendations to concrete trade-offs (latency vs cost vs quality). Proposal: design a compact, embeddable UI component ("Lenslet") that surfaces a recommended configuration, a 3-step narrative explaining why, quick toggles for safe rollback, and a tiny simulator showing expected cost/latency percentiles. Lenslet lives on the Route Settings page and the global Recommendations hub. The goal is to reduce configuration time and support safe defaults for PLG users while giving advanced teams an escape hatch.
acceptance_criteria: Lenslet prototype (Figma) demonstrates: recommended settings, three-line narrative, confidence band, and rollback toggle
Prototype includes a micro-simulator that shows 50th/95th latency and per-1M-token cost delta for current vs recommended settings
Usability test (n=6 engineers/ML) shows at least 80% of participants can identify the recommended trade-off and enable the config within 2 minutes
Design passes an engineering feasibility review (ENG-2987) with clear data inputs and API contract documented
PM sign-off on wording and guardrail thresholds; accessibility checks for color & screen reader text
design_notes: Lenslet is intentionally compact — 360px max width for embedding in side column; full-expansion modal for detailed simulation
The narrative is generated from a sparse rule engine: workload archetype + SLO target => heuristic reasons (e.g., 'High prefix reuse detected -> increase cache TTL to reduce tokens')
Confidence bands visualized as two-tone sparkline: median vs 95th; include numeric tooltips
Guardrails: 'Auto-apply (canary 5% -> full rollout)' or 'Suggest-only (manual apply)'; default for new users is 'suggest-only'
We will reuse existing cost APIs for token pricing and a lightweight simulation endpoint from ENG-2987; if simulation latency > 300ms show 'estimate unavailable' state
decisions: Named the component Lenslet to emphasize small, focused narrative — avoids overloading console with full optimizer UI
Recommendation layer will be rule-based initially (heuristics from product + research) with telemetry hooks for later ML scoring
Default presentation will show 'Recommended' + short reason; advanced collapse reveals exact numeric deltas and simulation inputs
We will include a one-click canary rollout path (5% traffic for 24h) as the primary safe-apply mechanism; full auto-rollout requires PM opt-in
